No. My memory holds the owner saying the opposite. When I over-corrected by cutting probes and delegates, and wrote a "17 delegates" rule, he rejected it: "Nigga I have not fucking said anything about reducing delegates".

His complaints were about useless tests and repeated CI: "I'm just against useless tests", "And repeating the same ci cd process multiple times for no reason", and "I will not accept such long and wasteful ci cd processes any longer! The simplest edits are taking you hours my guy".

He also did not say to cancel real tests. Real tests stay, and I shouldn't repeat the same check on an unchanged tree.
